description: Opening-balance, year-end-close and Kestrel special-period journals were written without the line attributes the approved mapping contract requires, so a conditional split could not be derived from the posting. The engine resolved them to the account's declared default branch, which was the only defensible answer available.
rationale: Closed. The three journal writers discarded the attributes they had already resolved; they now go through the same line resolver as every other posting. Mapping agreement across ALL lines is 100.000000%, so the exception has nothing left to except.
correction: src/generation/journals.py: opening_balance, year_end_close and special_period_adjustments resolve each line through JournalGenerator._resolve, which writes the required attributes

description: The same defect measured on the population it belongs to: postings to a conditional account that carried none of the attributes its rules read and therefore resolved to the wrong branch.
Seven Kestrel postings to 00017000 Aktive Rechnungsabgrenzung carried no accrual_type, so USD 2.33m sat in prepayments instead of contract assets at FY2025 and correspondingly in FY2023 and FY2024.
rationale: Closed with SX-001: those postings now carry accrual_type and land in contract assets. The mapped balance sheet reproduces the source-layer target for every caption-year.

description: Contract assets were driven to a credit balance at the Kestrel entities by the same unclassified accrued-income postings.
rationale: Closed with SX-001. No account class carries an inverted sign at any entity in any year.

description: A posting declared one classification in its line attributes and sat in a cost centre carrying another. The mapping contract names the declared attribute as authoritative, so the mapping was right; the cost-centre dimension did not corroborate it.
rationale: Closed. The cost centre is now CHOSEN to satisfy what the split requires, and the attribute is read back off the cost centre actually chosen, so the two views of a posting cannot disagree. Zero contradicting lines remain.
correction: src/generation/journals.py: JournalGenerator._cost_centre honours dept_code, dept_function and cost_center_function; src/generation/masters.py: D210 and D215 corrected to INDIRECT_OPS; config/dimensions/department.csv: D910 and D215 applicability corrected

description: The cash settlement leg of an intercompany balance, the group treasury current account and the intercompany loan accounts carried no counterparty, so an intercompany BALANCE could not be attributed to an entity pair.
rationale: Closed. Every intercompany balance is decomposed by counterparty and settled counterparty by counterparty, and the investment in each subsidiary names that subsidiary. 100% of the intercompany position is attributable to an entity pair and P2-IC-01 proves the pairs net to under USD 1 at closing rates.
correction: src/generation/ledger.py: ic_partner_balances and ic_loan_amounts; src/generation/series.py: _ic_trade_paths, per-period loan and investment decomposition; src/generation/journals.py: IC_BALANCE_ACCOUNTS settled per counterparty

description: Kestrel special period 15 reallocated between corporate income tax and trade tax, moving an amount from the income-taxes-payable caption into accrued liabilities.
rationale: Closed. The balance sheet leg was pointed at the VAT account, which is not an income tax; a true-up between Koerperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer reallocates the charge and leaves the payable unchanged, so it has no balance sheet leg at all.
correction: src/generation/journals.py: SPECIAL_PERIOD_ADJUSTMENTS[15] balance sheet leg removed
